ns2:course.label: Contemporary Health
ns2:course.description: Examines concepts of health and health promotion in contemporary society with emphasis on a healthy lifestyle for individuals and groups. Topics include self care, health insurance, exercise, nutrition and weight control, sexuality, contraception, tobacco, alcohol, cardiovascular health, infectious diseases, and cancer.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Enrollment required for Community Health Freshmen and transfer students. If enrolling in a face-to-face section, students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
